product.name: WebCited
product.description: WebCited scans your website against 5 major AI answer engines (ChatGPT, Gemini, Perplexity, Claude, Copilot) and shows exactly where you're cited or ignored. It then generates technical fixes — llms.txt, schema markup, comparison pages — to improve your visibility in AI search, and re-probes the engines to prove the fixes worked. First scan is free, no card required. Any website with a marketing page that wants to be found in AI search is a fit.
product.genre: AI search visibility / AEO (Answer Engine Optimization) — helps any website show up in ChatGPT, Gemini, Perplexity, Claude, Copilot answers

targeting.idealProspect: Founders or growth/marketing leads of newly launched B2B SaaS or web products with a public marketing website. ANY such product benefits because every new launch wants to be discovered — and buyers increasingly find tools through AI search. Bad fits: hardware, mobile-only apps with no real website, open-source libs with no commercial site, products whose site is just a waitlist page.
